title: Mass of an integer multiplicity current concentrates on any closed set off which it vanishes
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ k) and R an IMRep in univ of degree k representing X. Let F ⊆ ℝ^P be closed such that X vanishes off F, i.e. X(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^P) whose tsupport is disjoint from F. Then μ_R(ℝ^P ∖ F) = 0 (R.measure Fᶜ = 0), and M(X) ≤ M_W(X) for every open W ⊇ F.
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k) (F : Set (Euclid P)), R.Represents X → IsClosed F → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) (F) → X ω = 0) → R.measure Fᶜ = 0 ∧ ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → F ⊆ W → X.mass ≤ X.massOn W
